questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some balls are toys.

All toys are plastic.

No plastic is water.

Conclusions:

(I): Some balls are plastic.

(II): No toy is water.
questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ff7fc2e4123f41026aa3915e7b0de9d9d51c130ca4640b69d1f974c8e1efe7a.png] 

Conclusions:

(I): Some balls are plastic → **True**(As Some balls are toys, All toys are plastic. so, Some balls are plastic holds true)

(II): No toy is water → **True**( All toys are plastic, No plastic is water. so, No toy is water is definitely true)

Thus, Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

questions.question:
Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In row 1, G, L, O and F are seated and all of them are facing south.

In row 2, B, E, S and T are seated and all of them are facing north.

Thus, each person faces another person from the other row.

No one sits to the left of S. No one sits to the left of L. Only one person sits between T and S. The one facing E sits second to the right of L. O sits second to the right of G.

Which of the following represents both people sitting at extreme ends of the rows?
questions.solution:
Given:

In row 1, G, L, O and F are seated and all of them are facing south.

In row 2, B, E, S and T are seated and all of them are facing north.

Thus, each person faces another person from the other row.

No one sits to the left of S. No one sits to the left of L.

Only one person sits between T and S.

The one facing E sits second to the right of L, means the person sits second to the right of L who facing E.

O sits second to the right of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a12160f7269ca18608780fca027913085d3941c68d62117f270e6849d23117f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e249855e088ad42e46b7fea68e3290fa0778cf9d01f96be55b01af51af1728f4.png] 

Thus, O and B sitting at extreme ends of the rows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

questions.question: The position(s) of how many letters will remain unchanged if each of the letters in the word ROTCHES is arranged in the English alphabetical order?
questions.solution:
Given:

**Arrange Letters in English Alphabetical Order:**

The letters in "ROTCHES" are: C, E, H, O, R, S, T.

Original Word: R O T C H E S

Updated Word: C E H O R S T

Thus, no letters remain in their original positions after arranging the word "ROTCHES" in alphabetical order.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

48 × 3 − 16 + 6 ÷ 3 =?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/c0j5U9v2oJWEzSTKvdDLWZ5Zik3PBUXk-C9w3Ma990WH63rpQUfA7g-3wh_uT7CgFvFJ4jPGEeOw509FxSgfh78_HR9tDNZ9KitXdEveKsLaLMgPQf6YSDt1b775728JMVp9FIQs=s0] 

According to the question, the signs are interchanged as follows:

 
 

 Original Symbol
 +
 −
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 New Symbol
 −
 +
 ÷
 ×
 
 

Now,

Given e×pression: 48 × 3 − 16 + 6 ÷ 3 = ?

After interchanging the specified signs:

⇒ 48 ÷ 3 + 16 − 6 × 3

Perform operations according to BODMAS/PEMDAS:

⇒ __**48 ÷ 3**__ + 16 − 6 × 3

⇒ 16 + 16 − __**6 × 3**__

⇒ __**16 + 16**__ − 18

⇒ __**32 − 18**__

⇒ 14

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
In a certain code language,

'A + B' means 'A is the daughter of B',

'A - B' means 'A is the brother of B',

'A x B' means 'A is the sister of B' and

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the son of B'.

How is G related to E if 'E + F x G - H ÷ I'?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b179341100c8a851a46dc1aeabdc53868fb34279e298fc2277f663263597bc68.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 A is

 +
 -
 x
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Daughter
 Brother
 Sister
 Son
 
 

 to B
 
 

Given: E + F x G - H ÷ I

**E + F** → E is the daughter of F.

**F x G** → F is the sister of G.

**G - H** → G is the brother of H.

**H ÷ I** → H is the son of I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cce3f8d7ddbba3953fa18238107a922bb8c8760681b325637828b75a2d48eb7e.png] 

Thus, G is the mother's brother of E.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
